name: Mi 3

images.credit: Roland Tanglao, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Operating system: Original: MIUI V5 (Android 4.3 Jelly Bean), Current: MIUI 9 (Android 4.4 Kitkat for TD-LTE Version) (Android 6.0 Marshmallow for WCDMA/CDMA Version)
Platform.CPU: 2.3 GHz Qualcomm Snapdragon 800 MSM8274AB/8674AB Quad-Core Krait 400 (WCDMA/CDMA), 1.8 GHz Nvidia Tegra 4 4+1 Core Cortex-A15 (TD-LTE)

Display.Display: IPS Display 5 inches @ 1920px x 1080px (441 PPI) (Manufactured by Sharp or LG)

Cameras.Rear camera: 13 Megapixels (backside-illuminated (BSI)), with a super-large Sony Exmor sensor and an f/2.2 aperture, built-in Phillips dual-CFL flash. Records 1080p at 30fps and 720p at 120fps

Battery.Battery: 3050mAh, up to 500hrs standby time, up to 25hrs talk time and up to 50hrs music playback

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 4.0 + A2DP, ANT+, Dual-band Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n), Wi-Fi Direct, Wi-Fi Display, Micro-USB On-The-Go with MHL link, DLNA, NFC, GPS + GLONASS, AGPS
